from.place: proof, finite-flat duality, degree-zero identification, counit evaluation, and the module-linearity formula

title: Finite flat duality with an invertible target
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] morphism of Noetherian schemes and let $L$ be an invertible $\mathcal O_Y$-module [def-sc-invertible-module]. Write $f^!L$ for the right adjoint image of $L$ under $Rf_*$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image]; it is a sheaf in degree zero. There is a canonical $f_*\mathcal O_X$-linear isomorphism $\Phi:f_*f^!L\cong\mathcal H om_{\mathcal O_Y}(f_*\mathcal O_X,L)$, where $f_*\mathcal O_X$ acts on the right by precomposition with multiplication. Under this isomorphism the adjunction counit $f_*f^!L\to L$ is evaluation at $1$, and for every local section $a$ of $f_*\mathcal O_X$ and $\omega$ of $f_*f^!L$ one has $\Phi(\omega)(a)=\Phi(a\omega)(1)$.

source.place: Tag 0BVI, Lemma 49.15.2 (finite flat case), and Tag 0FKW, Section 49.5 (evaluation and invertible target)

proof.text: For a finite morphism of Noetherian schemes, finite duality gives the canonical $f_*\mathcal O_X$-linear identification $Rf_*f^!L\simeq R\mathcal H om_{\mathcal O_Y}(f_*\mathcal O_X,L)$, and its adjunction counit is induced by evaluation at the unit section $1$.

Because $f$ is finite over the Noetherian scheme $Y$, its affine chart algebras are finite type over Noetherian rings and hence finitely presented by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-noetherian-finite-presentation]. With flatness, [lem-sc-finite-pushforward-locally-free] gives that $f_*\mathcal O_X$ is locally isomorphic to a finite free module, with locally constant rank. Thus [lem-sc-finite-locally-free-derived-hom] gives $R\mathcal H om_{\mathcal O_Y}(f_*\mathcal O_X,L)\simeq\mathcal H om_{\mathcal O_Y}(f_*\mathcal O_X,L)$ in degree zero.

Since $f$ is finite, it is affine. Applying [lem-sc-affine-derived-concentration] to the finite-duality object shows that $f^!L$ itself is represented by a sheaf in degree zero whenever its derived pushforward is; the degree-zero identification from the previous step therefore yields the asserted sheaf $f^!L$ and the displayed Hom isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 0AVW, perfect-lemma-affine-morphism-equivalence, and the affine derived pushforward discussion in Derived Categories of Schemes

proof.text: The module-linearity formula is elementary: for the precomposition action, $(a\cdot\Phi(\omega))(1)=\Phi(\omega)(a\cdot1)=\Phi(\omega)(a)$, while $a\cdot\Phi(\omega)=\Phi(a\omega)$ by $f_*\mathcal O_X$-linearity. Thus $\Phi(\omega)(a)=\Phi(a\omega)(1)$.
